builds.name: nxnative
builds.about: Upstream nxnative's Pokopia profile (2.0.1 / v655360 only): builds all ~131,000 shaders, which takes hours (about 6.5 h on an M4 Max before its latest speed-ups) and over 200 GB of disk while it builds.

builds.name: horizon-nx2
builds.about: joaoalvess's nxnative port tuned for a fanless 16 GB MacBook Air M4 (MIT), for Pokopia 2.0.1: the opening, the character choice and the first area at about 60 fps, a 31-minute playtest with no crash.

choose.why: horizon-nx2 is Pokopia's own build now that pokopia-native is no longer available (tuned on a fanless 16 GB MacBook Air); nxnative's full build takes hours and over 200 GB of disk
